title: Clipboard handoff to agent terminal
description: Gets capture out of Design Mode and into agent via clipboard
body: Getting a capture out of this app and into an agent. **The clipboard, deliberately, and for now.** What this feature wants is to put the text straight into whichever terminal an agent is running in, and the shell has no verb for that yet. A clipboard write needs no Tauri capability, no new command and no protocol change.
